groups.root_cause: The MCP status code uses the saved PR observation and ignores the run's confirmed merge flag, so a PR the factory has confirmed as merged is reported as needing review or as unknown.
The MCP status code lets a past blocked landing attempt take priority over the PR's current closed state.
The digest's acknowledgement cursor hides PRs that need review again after their approval was acknowledged, even when new commits arrive and CI passes.
The digest's awaiting-review filter does not exclude PRs whose run is still active (fixing, delivering or waiting to merge).
The digest treats a missing saved PR snapshot as a missing approval, so a PR that is already approved is listed as awaiting review.
When the privacy policy file cannot be read, mutation tools still run but their MCP responses drop the result fields, including the identifier.
When the privacy policy is unavailable, limitless_status returns only the land summary and question count, leaving out the state and the next action.
The digest's quoting of PR titles does not escape bidi-control or zero-width characters.
GET /api/land returns 400 instead of 404 when the run does not exist.
The Codex skill file tells Codex to use the Claude consumer name, so it reads Claude's cursor instead of its own.
The MCP review and land handlers pass the backend's mutation result through without checking it against a schema.
